messages:
mike: ops requested a delegated emergency token flow for tenant console. idea: delegate limited SA permissions to oncall so they can rollback a model without owning long-lived keys. pros/cons?
anita: sounds useful but we need strict scoping. the token should only allow route-change and model-select for that tenant and be ephemeral.
leo: agree. also we need quota attribution rules: token must include original_project claim so billing attributes correctly. can't have orphaned traffic.
claire: UX ask: show approver chain and a one-click revoke in console. also surface the exact permissions being delegated before approving.
mike: policy thought: mint via /tokens/delegate with claims: delegated_for=tenant_id, allowed_actions=[route_change,model_select], ttl=300s, approvers=[ids]
leo: router change: when seeing delegated token, add header x-rwd-delegation=audit_id and tag telemetry with delegation=true and origin_project claim.
anita: telemetry events: delegation_created, delegation_revoked, delegation_usage. alerts: >2 delegations in 1h for same tenant.
claire: security: require SSO + 2FA for approvers, require approver not equal to requester, and record IP + device in audit log.
audit-bot: note: audit-store will persist delegation records immutably with fields: actor, approver_ids, tenant_id, allowed_actions, audit_id, timestamp.
leo: billing: finance wants a flag in exported billing rows for delegated_activity so they can reconcile. add bill_flag=delegated
mike: rollout: behind ff 'delegated-emergency-tokens', internal orgs only. we'll prototype with hard RPS cap and require backend revoke endpoint.
anita: implementation: reuse token service but add delegation namespace and immutable audit_id. revoke should zero out token grant server-side.
claire: UX mock: confirmation modal requires typing tenant name + selecting approvers and checking a box "I accept audit will be generated".
leo: dev plan: I'll open a PR for token service + router header pass-through. Anita will draft threat model. Claire will do mock.
mike: decision: prototype behind flag with hard caps, audit hooks, approver gating. file ticket and assign.
audit-bot: created issue #7710 by mike: https://rwd/gh/7710 "delegated emergency tokens for tenant console (prototype behind flag)"
